map.类型映射：mapping→表、sequence→数组表/数组、标量→字符串/整数: Type mapping: mapping→table, sequence→array table/array, scalar→string/integer/float/boolean/date
map.两种格式都表达「键值 + 嵌套」的配置树，但语法差异显著：YAML 依赖缩进与: Both formats express a "key-value + nesting" config tree, but their syntax differs sharply: YAML relies on indentation and - lists, while TOML declares tables with [table], table arrays with [[table]], and uses dots or headers for hierarchy. A key constraint for TOML is "tables must come after all plain keys", so the converter must output root-level scalar keys first, then headers by hierarchy; YAML null has no TOML type and is usually dropped or becomes empty string; multi-line strings, anchors and aliases (&/*) can't map directly and must be expanded first. Verify by readback with a TOML parser after conversion.
map.转换按结构等价进行：YAML 映射→TOML 表，YAML 列表→TOML 数组: Conversion is structurally equivalent: YAML mapping→TOML table, YAML list→TOML array; nested mappings expand into [section] sub-tables.
map.TOML 不支持 YAML 的锚点/合并（&anchor、*alias）与多行折: TOML doesn't support YAML's anchors/merge (&anchor, *alias) and multi-line folding; such advanced syntax is ignored or errors.
map.字符串中含特殊字符（冒号、#、方括号等）会自动加引号以保证 TOML 合法。: Strings with special characters (colon, #, brackets) are auto-quoted to keep the TOML valid.
map.本工具支持常见子集（映射、列表、标量、注释、嵌套小节）；极复杂 YAML 建议先: This tool supports a common subset (mappings, lists, scalars, comments, nested sections); for very complex YAML, route through JSON first.

map.为什么转换后结构变得很啰嗦？: Why did the result become verbose?
map.因为 TOML 需要为每个层级显式写表头（[a.b.c]），而 YAML 用缩进: Because TOML must explicitly write a header ([a.b.c]) for every level, while YAML implies it by indentation; deeper hierarchy means more headers — a normal consequence of the format difference. If the source heavily uses anchors (&/*) or multi-document (---), expand them before conversion — most converters won't handle these automatically.
